analysis.executive_summary: Documentation audit of https://unkey.com/docs covered 114 pages with 100.88% crawl coverage and 91.5% overall confidence. Critical issues include 17 confirmed broken internal documentation links requiring immediate remediation. API reference coverage is severely deficient at 13.16% despite 33 API pages detected, indicating incomplete documentation of available endpoints. Example code reliability scored 0.0%, representing a complete absence of validated or testable code samples. Freshness metadata exists for 76.32% of pages, while SEO/geo issues affect 9.65% of content.
strengths: Complete crawl coverage at 100.88% with all 114 discovered pages successfully examined
High overall audit confidence at 91.5% with strong link verification (95%) and crawl reliability (95%)
Single-product topology provides clear documentation structure and navigation model
No repository navigation link breakage (0 repo_broken_links_count), indicating healthy source control integration
Majority of pages (76.32%) include last-updated metadata supporting freshness tracking
risks: 17 confirmed broken internal documentation links create poor user experience and erode trust in documentation quality
API reference coverage at 13.16% leaves 86.84% of API surface undocumented, blocking developer adoption and integration
Example reliability at 0.0% indicates no working code samples, forcing users to debug documentation errors
Zero validated examples increase support burden and slow time-to-first-success for new developers
23.68% of pages lack freshness metadata, obscuring content staleness and maintenance gaps
SEO/geo issues on 9.65% of pages may reduce discoverability in search engines and international markets
Low API confidence score (85%) suggests potential gaps in automated API endpoint detection or documentation structure

prioritized_actions.action: Fix all 17 broken internal documentation links through automated link validation in CI/CD pipeline
Expand API reference documentation from 13.16% to minimum 80% coverage by documenting missing endpoints, parameters, and response schemas
Implement executable code examples with automated testing to achieve minimum 60% example reliability score
Add last-updated metadata to remaining 23.68% of pages and establish quarterly content review process
Remediate SEO/geo issues on affected 9.65% of pages (meta descriptions, canonical tags, language declarations)

limitations: External audit cannot verify technical accuracy of API documentation content, parameter types, or response examples against actual API behavior
Example code reliability scoring depends on detectable patterns; custom or embedded code samples may not be fully assessed
API coverage detection relies on documentation structure conventions; non-standard reference page formats may undercount actual coverage
Audit cannot assess documentation completeness for proprietary features, internal tools, or undisclosed API capabilities
Freshness metadata presence does not guarantee content accuracy or reflect actual product changes since last update
